description: This file contains auxiliary functions, data structures, and constants related to PostScript fonts within the FreeType project. It defines structures for managing PostScript tables, tokens, fields, parsers, glyph builders, decoders, and font parsers, along with function pointer interfaces and utility macros.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a PS_Table or parser or builder or decoder object.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Finalizes or releases resources for a PS_Table or parser or builder or decoder object.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an object to a PS_Table.

methods.name: skip_spaces
methods.description: Skips whitespace in the parser input.

methods.name: skip_PS_token
methods.description: Skips a PostScript token in the parser input.

methods.name: to_int
methods.description: Converts parser input to an integer.

methods.name: to_fixed
methods.description: Converts parser input to a fixed-point number.

methods.name: to_coord_array
methods.description: Reads an array of coordinates from parser input.

methods.name: to_fixed_array
methods.description: Reads an array of fixed-point values from parser input.

methods.name: to_token
methods.description: Extracts a token from parser input.

methods.name: to_token_array
methods.description: Extracts an array of tokens from parser input.

methods.name: load_field
methods.description: Loads a field from parser input into an object.

methods.name: load_field_table
methods.description: Loads a table of fields from parser input into objects.

methods.name: t1_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a buffer using the T1 font encryption algorithm.
